== Biography ==
Agnes was born before 1709. She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-1440|Patrick Glasgow]] and [[Fairburn-170|Helen Fairburn]]. 
* Fact: Christening (31 Jul 1709)  Stitchel, Roxburghshire, Scotland
